description: This file defines HTTP handlers and underlying logic for managing and retrieving workflow DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs) of execution records, including full and lightweight representations, as well as session-based workflows. It handles API endpoints related to fetching workflow DAGs, their children, and session workflows, utilizing a storage interface for data retrieval and building hierarchical DAG structures.

classes.name: executionRecordProvider
classes.description: Interface defining methods for querying execution records from storage.

classes.name: executionGraphService
classes.description: Struct encapsulating methods for handling workflow DAG HTTP requests and related logic.

classes.name: WorkflowDAGNode
classes.description: Struct representing a node in the detailed (full) workflow DAG, including execution metadata and hierarchical children.

classes.name: WorkflowDAGResponse
classes.description: Struct for the JSON response containing a detailed workflow DAG, summary info, and timeline.

classes.name: SessionWorkflowsResponse
classes.description: Struct for response listing workflows within a session, including root and all workflows.

classes.name: WorkflowDAGLightweightNode
classes.description: Simplified node structure for lightweight DAG representations.

classes.name: WorkflowDAGLightweightResponse
classes.description: Response struct for lightweight workflow DAG, summary info, and timeline.

methods.name: GetWorkflowDAGHandler
methods.description: Factory function returning a Gin handler for fetching a workflow DAG.

methods.name: handleGetWorkflowDAG
methods.description: Method to handle HTTP request for retrieving a workflow DAG, either detailed or lightweight.

methods.name: GetWorkflowChildrenHandler
methods.description: Factory for handler that retrieves child executions of a given workflow.

methods.name: handleGetWorkflowChildren
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to fetch child workflow executions of a specified parent.

methods.name: GetSessionWorkflowsHandler
methods.description: Factory for handler that retrieves all workflows associated with a session.

methods.name: handleGetSessionWorkflows
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve workflows within a specified session.

methods.name: loadRunExecutions
methods.description: Loads all executions for a specific run ID from storage.

methods.name: buildExecutionDAG
methods.description: Constructs the detailed hierarchy DAG and timeline from execution records.

methods.name: BuildWorkflowDAG
methods.description: Exports the DAG construction logic for external use.

methods.name: buildLightweightExecutionDAG
methods.description: Builds a simplified, lightweight version of the execution DAG.

methods.name: executionToDAGNode
methods.description: Converts an execution record into a detailed DAG node.

methods.name: deriveOverallStatus
methods.description: Determines the overall status of a set of executions based on their states.

methods.name: executionToLightweightNode
methods.description: Converts an execution record into a lightweight DAG node.

methods.name: isLightweightRequest
methods.description: Determines if the HTTP request requests a lightweight DAG based on query parameters.
